'''Rhemer''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed at the Republic quarters at the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Voss]], [[Voss-Ka]].
